sentences.text: Alok Kumar Ghose & Anr vs Unknown on 2 March, 2016

Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
103. 02.03.2016 C.R.R. 584 of 2016 Aloke Ct. No.28 In the matter of : Alok Kumar Ghose & Anr.
Mr. Siladitya Sanyal Mr. Sujan ... for the petitioners

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the prosecution is barred by limitation in view of Section 77 of the Act Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" four weeks hence.
A copy of the petition be served upon the Opposite Party Nos. 1 and 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.

There shall be stay of proceeding in C.R. Case No. 666 of 2015 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 3rd Court, Jalpaiguri under clause (zx) & (zz) (iii), (v), (vii) and (viii) of sub-Section (1)
of Section 3 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 for a period of six weeks or until further order, whichever is earlier.
